title: Listening Drill — Food waste survey
description: Fieldwork briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Food waste survey
sections.transcript:
LEADER: Let me explain how we'll collect data about how much food is left after lunch. Each pair will have the same instructions. That matters because another group needs to be able to repeat what you've done.

LEADER: Start with the first container. Record the first reading at one. The quantity we're comparing is food weight. Use the digital scale marked with blue tape.

LEADER: At the end, remove the empty container weight. If you miss a reading, mark it as missing. Don't fill in a number by copying the nearest result.
